BL-769 — DEFECT — Bubble has no test seam of any kind, so every Android ticket must choose between an inert acceptance contract and none at all
What it solves: Typed `defect` rather than `feature`, deliberately, and it is arguable: nothing
regressed, the seam never existed. It is filed as a defect because the
consequence is a broken verification signal — five tickets have shipped with
contracts that assert nothing, and the pipeline reported them green — w…
Approval context: This ticket exists because eleven raw Bubble intakes and BL-761 are all parked on one unanswered question, and it is costing real work: BL-716 landed on 2026-08-01 as the fifth shipped ticket whose acceptance contract runs zero scenarios. BL-761's own approval_context recommended settling this FIRS…
BL-769 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-769" (or "reject BL-769 <reason>") to act.
